entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you with the next available agent.
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return something.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex, how can I help you today?
I want to return a VeloBand Pulse I bought a couple of weeks ago. It's just not what I expected.
Okay, I understand. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase, please?
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order. Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse purchase. What's the reason for the return?
It's not tracking my sleep properly and the heart rate monitor is wonky. I expected more from this smart watch, honestly. I've only had it a little over two weeks.

I understand your frustration. At VeloFit, we strive for customer satisfaction. Our standard return policy is 90 days. Since you are well within that window, a return is absolutely possible. You can return it for a full refund. To initiate the return, I'll send you a prepaid shipping label via email.
90 days? Really? I thought I saw something about a shorter window for electronics. But great! That’s a relief. I was worried because I’m past the 10 days I thought I read about online.

Yes, our standard return policy is 90 days for most items, and that applies to your VeloBand Pulse as well. No need to worry about that 10 days you mentioned, that must have been something else. You’ll receive an email with the shipping label within the next hour. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse in its original packaging, affix the label, and drop it off at any authorized carrier location.
Okay, that sounds easy enough. So I just use the label and send it back? That's all?
That's correct. Once we receive the returned VeloBand Pulse, we'll process the refund back to your original payment method. You should see it reflected in your account within 7-10 business days.
Wonderful! Thank you so much! I was really stressed about this. I really appreciate you helping me with this VeloBand Pulse return.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's everything. Thanks again for your help. You've been great.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
